name: home-hub
description: Home Hub – eine App für MyGekko, DoorBird, Reolink, Sonos und Spotify

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w hub
scripts.demo: npm run build && HUB_DEMO=1 npm run start -w hub
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w hub && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w hub && npm run test -w web
